municipal3d.status: Downloaded and used: municipal tile 212221, components 240 (theatre) and 508 (library), clipped and converted into waterfront-model.json; registered in the local game.
municipal3d.detail: Mostly LOD1, centre partly LOD2. Geometry may support dimensions, but needs validation against current exterior photos.
municipal3d.qualification: Actual municipal LOD1 mesh triangles, not a detailed textured scan. Roof stage and facade additions are separately interpreted from CC0 photos. Library footprint agrees within 0.32 m of OSM bounding edges; theatre within 3.02 m. Source elevations retained; precise vertical datum remains unconfirmed.

pointCloud.status: Source found; covers an approximately 10 ha downtown flight. Theatre/library coverage is not yet verified.

architecture.use: Factual reference: library glass facade reported as 54 metres. Do not assume linked photographs/PDF illustrations carry the municipal model licence.
